question: In which season of the Ultimate Kho-Kho League tournament was Ramji Kashyap awarded the Player of the tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Season 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ramji Kashyap was awarded the **Player of the Tournament** in the **Season 2** of the Ultimate Kho-Kho League.
 
• The Ultimate Kho-Kho League is a professional kho-kho league in India established to popularize the traditional Indian sport of kho-kho.
 
• Season 2 of the league witnessed exceptional performances, with Ramji Kashyap standing out as the most impactful player.
 
• His contributions in both attacking and defensive plays were instrumental for his team’s success in the tournament.
 
• The league is aimed at promoting traditional Indian sports and providing a platform for players to showcase their talent on a national stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ultimate Kho-Kho League (UKKL):**

 
 
• The Ultimate Kho-Kho League is India’s first-ever professional kho-kho league, launched to revive and modernize the traditional Indian sport of kho-kho.
 
• It follows a franchise-based model, with teams representing different regions of India.
 
• The league incorporates modern techniques like real-time analytics and player fitness tracking to enhance the competitiveness of the sport.
 
 
 
• **Rules and Gameplay of Kho-Kho:**
 
 
• Kho-kho is a traditional Indian tag sport played by two teams, with each consisting of 12 players (9 active and 3 substitutes).
 
• The game is played in two innings, where one team chases while the other defends, and roles are reversed after the first inning.
 
• The objective is to tag as many opponents as possible within the allotted time.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the League:**
 
 
• The Ultimate Kho-Kho League has brought kho-kho into the limelight, encouraging younger generations to take up the sport.
 
• It has also provided financial opportunities and recognition for players who excel at the game.
 
• By blending traditional sports with modern broadcasting methods, the league has attracted a larger audience and sponsors.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Players:**
 
 
• Alongside Ramji Kashyap, other players have also gained recognition for their performances in the league, showcasing the depth of talent in Indian kho-kho.
 
• These players have been scouted from regional and national tournaments, highlighting the grassroots strength of the sport.
